name: Elise Dubois
bio:
Elise's passion for motorsport ignited during her engineering studies at ETH Zurich. Captivated by the intricate dance of data and performance, she channeled her analytical skills into motorsport, starting with Formula Student. After graduating, she joined a smaller F3 team, where she honed her abilities in extracting meaningful insights from limited data. Her keen eye for detail and innovative approach to data analysis quickly set her apart, leading to a move to Prema Racing. 

At Prema, Elise thrives on the challenge of optimizing car setup and race strategy using advanced telemetry. She believes in the power of combining rigorous statistical analysis with a deep understanding of the car's dynamics. Her distinctive ability to identify subtle patterns in data that others miss has made her an invaluable asset to the team, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible on the track. Elise is known for her commitment to continuous improvement, always seeking new ways to leverage data to gain a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elise is of average height with a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with calculations and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to classical music through noise-cancelling headphones while analyzing race data.
